name: Messaging, hourly
description: Every hour: sends the scheduled messages whose time has come and evaluates the active digest, nudge and repeating messages (app\concepts\messaging\Runner::hourly). Each recipient is written to the msgsend ledger before the message goes out, so a run that is repeated or interrupted never sends twice.

config.command: php -r 'require "vendor/autoload.php"; require \app\Paths::runtime() . "/bin/_boot.php"; new app\Bootstrap("conf/config.ini"); echo implode("\n", \app\concepts\messaging\Runner::hourly()) . "\n";'
